question_text: A government employee applying for a promotion is required to undergo mandatory drug testing. The employee refuses, citing the right to privacy. Which of the following best justifies the mandatory drug testing policy?

options.text: RA 9165 mandates drug testing for all government employees as a condition for employment and promotion.
The Civil Service Commission (CSC) requires drug testing only for employees suspected of drug use.
Drug testing is voluntary and cannot be imposed as a condition for promotion.
Only elected officials are required to undergo drug testing under RA 9165.
